Class AesGcmPayloadTransformer

java.lang.Object
org.jwcarman.substrate.crypto.AesGcmPayloadTransformer
All Implemented Interfaces:
PayloadTransformer
public class AesGcmPayloadTransformer extends Object implements PayloadTransformer
AES-GCM payload transformer that encrypts and decrypts payload bytes using keys resolved via a SecretKeyResolver. The wire format is [kid(4) | nonce(12) | ciphertext + GCM tag].

Thread-safe: each call creates a fresh Cipher instance.
